APPROVE
The extracted `JudgeCall` and `ResolveRoute` keep every original check in the same order, and each method now scores well under 15 (about 11 for `JudgeCall`, 3 for the loop); this rests on reading the diff, since I couldn't build it here, and the one construct to confirm is `is not var (path, receiver, middle)`, which deconstructs the nullable tuple and so correctly treats `null` as a non-match.
